stem.text: A hill separates a television (TV) transmitter from a house. The transmitter cannot be seen from the house. However, the house has good TV reception.

stem.alt: Ground line with a TV transmitter tower on the left, a rounded hill in the middle labelled hill, and a house on the right, labelled house. The labels TV transmitter and house are printed below the tower and the house.

stem.text: By which wave effect at the hill could the TV signal reach the house?
